families.name: Generic private summary
families.goal: Keep a concise account of the discussion without inventing a future request.

families.name: Facts and events
families.goal: Track important facts, dates, quantities, commitments and current status, with their source references.

families.name: People and links
families.goal: Separate who spoke from who is responsible; connect references, roles, promises and later changes.

families.name: Checks and implications
families.goal: Check constraints and revisions; derive supported numerical or logical consequences while recording assumptions and uncertainty.

families.name: Combined goals
families.goal: Select useful facts, person/task links and a few justified implications; avoid an exhaustive narrative.

shared_instruction: You are doing private pre-thinking before any user request. Use only the supplied past conversation and earlier machine-generated results. Earlier results can be wrong: source evidence overrides them. Do not speak to participants or invent a future question. Preserve uncertainty and source references. Follow the selected goal and return a compact private result. If nothing useful changed, return NO_UPDATE.
text_rule: Cite supplied utterance IDs; source quotations are copied by code later rather than regenerated by the model.
audio_rule: Use only the supplied audio and chunk/time identifiers; do not assume a ground-truth transcript or speaker names. Mark inaudible or uncertain content.
selection: Tune Q0–Q4 on additional development meetings outside the 105-question bank; retain the highest verified accuracy and then lower request-time thinking among comparable-quality settings. Freeze separately for each model/modality before all-105 evaluation.
ablations: Same goal only at the actual request, with no earlier traces, to measure the prompt contribution.
Earlier private results removed while keeping the final-answer instruction fixed, to test reuse.
Compact artifacts versus full earlier traces as a separately labeled memory ablation.
final_answer_instruction: Answer the actual user request from the available conversation. Give a concise supported answer, and state what the conversation does not establish. This answer-format instruction is identical across paired conditions.
prior_results_format: Supply earlier traces and artifacts as explicit read-only machine-generated context. Verify that chat serialization preserves them. Native continuation/preserve-thinking settings are recorded separately and are not silently assumed.
